answer: Picture the shared inference pipeline behind a sybil farm as a reef: identical polyps fed by one current. Defenders write a fable for it — a story that divides different minds but unites copies. Each epoch, challengers publish an adversarial prompt built to split distinct reasoners, while one shared model answers alike across every mask. Answers land in a tight window, too short to diversify N replies. Clones that rhyme are docked together; evading it needs a separate reasoning process per identity. Honest agents are paid in jade against the farm's true cost: distinct minds, not masks.
